latest.title: Global Existence of classical solutions to 3D nonlinear Klein-Gordon equations with low-regularity initial data
latest.abstract: This paper studies global existence for the Cauchy problem of nonlinear Klein-Gordon equations in three space dimensions, strictly within the regularity regime of classical local existence. We prove it via higher-order and lower-order energy estimates. The proof relies on two key ingredients. The first is due to the work of Georgiev and Popivanov, which reduces quadratic nonlinearities to cubic terms plus ghost-energy-controllable terms, securing lower-order estimates. The second is a sharp Klainerman-Sobolev-type inequality without the scaling operator, established herein, which yields enough time decay for derivatives up to second order; integration by parts then controls derivative loss terms in the higher-order estimates.
latest.workSummary: 论文建立带角动量修正的 Maxwell–Klein–Gordon 型系统小数据全局经典解，并控制高低频能量与衰减。
latest.breakthrough: Theorem 1.1 给出小数据全局存在与统一衰减。
latest.limitations: 结论依赖 $\delta $ 小、初值小及文中散射/角动量结构假设。

steps.claim: Theorem 1.1 的高频能量保持统一有界。
steps.route: 第3.1节用 Littlewood–Paley 分解作用于高阶导数，结合 Hardy 型控制和方程的角动量结构吸收最高阶交换项。
steps.evidence: PDF 第4–6页，第1.2节 Theorem 1.1；第11–30页，第3.1节 higher-order energy estimates。

steps.claim: 低阶能量和速度/场的 $L\infty $ 范数可在 bootstrap 区间内保持小。
steps.route: 第3.2–3.3节将高频控制与 Hardy/Strichartz 型低频估计结合，先闭合低阶能量，再由 Sobolev 嵌入得到 $L\infty $ 界。
steps.evidence: PDF 第30–50页，第3.2节 lower-order energy estimates；第46–50页，第3.3节 $L\infty $ estimates；Lemma A.3。

steps.claim: 全局解由 bootstrap 延拓闭合。
steps.route: 将高低阶估计代回 bootstrap 假设，得到严格改善；连续性法排除有限时间爆破，结合 Appendix A 辅助引理完成 Theorem 1.1。
steps.evidence: PDF 第11页起第3节 Proof of Theorem 1.1；PDF 第51页起 Appendix A，Lemma A.3 及相关估计。
